If you want to wish someone a good start of Ramadan, it is customary to say "Ramadan Mubarak", which means "Blessed Ramadan". You can also say "Ramadan Kareem", which translates as "Generous Ramadan".
How long does Ramadan last?
The Islamic calendar follows the lunar cycle. Each month begins with the sighting of the new crescent moon and lasts either 29 or 30 days. In 2024, Ramadan lasted 30 days, with fasting having started on Monday 11 March. It ended on Wednesday 10 April.
